g.text: Moving auth token resolution off the cookie jar and onto the request
scope, with the legacy header path kept behind a flag.
Auth token reads from the cookie jar on every request
Legacy header auth path has no deprecation plan
Auth guide still documents the cookie-jar read
Second cookie fallback has no test and nobody knows why it ex…
confirmation run and a changelog entry.
One thing for you rather than for me: the uncovered cookie fallback. I
can either write a test that pins today's behaviour, or delete the
branch — but not both, and I do not know which one is right.
